versions.changelog:
rollinggo-hotel-booking-global v0.1.0

- Initial release of the RollingGo Hotel Search & Booking Assistant skill.
- Supports full hotel booking workflow: search, filter, real-time room types & prices, compare hotels, and booking guidance.
- Triggered by a wide range of accommodation-related queries (location, price, facility, brand, etc.).
- Enforces output formatting: only essential hotel info shown to users, strictly no technical details.
- Introduces robust login/auth flows and two-step booking confirmation for secure transactions.
